hero.headline: Digital ordering and reservations built to grow your restaurant.

sections.heading: The restaurant opportunity
sections.subheading: Take back control of your customer relationships and stop losing 20-30% on delivery commissions.
sections.introSuffix: thank you for considering us. We propose a fast, mobile-friendly restaurant website and direct ordering platform that puts your brand first, makes ordering seamless for diners, and connects directly to your kitchen.

outcomes.title: Zero Commission Orders
outcomes.body: Keep 100% of your delivery and pickup sales instead of paying heavy third-party app margins.

outcomes.title: Direct Table Reservations
outcomes.body: Allow customers to book tables 24/7 with instant confirmation and automated reminders.

outcomes.title: Interactive Digital Menu
outcomes.body: Showcase high-resolution photos, dietary tags, daily specials, and QR-code dine-in menus.

tiers.title: Online Food Ordering Hub

Customer receipt generation and SMS / WhatsApp notifications
30 days post-launch bug support and staff training session

sections.footer: Add-ons can be selected now or added after launch based on your growth targets.

sections.heading: Project timeline & launch process
sections.subheading: A structured 4-step sequence from tasting your menu to accepting your first online order.

steps.title: 1. Menu & Setup
steps.body: Collect your menu, dish photos, pricing, delivery zones, and payment account details.

steps.title: 2. Design & Build
steps.body: Build the custom storefront, configure ordering logic, toppings, and table reservation flows.

steps.title: 3. Kitchen Testing
steps.body: Test sample orders, notification sounds, mobile money payments, and train restaurant staff.

steps.title: 4. Launch & Print
steps.body: Connect domain, generate table QR codes, and go live to accept customer orders.

sections.heading: Commercial terms & deliverables
sections.subheading: Clear responsibilities and transparent milestone payments.

terms.title: Payment milestones
terms.body: 50% upfront to initiate design and development, 30% upon approval of menu and ordering flows, and 20% before final launch and staff handover.

terms.title: Domain & hosting
terms.body: Web hosting, domain registration (.com or .gh), and third-party SMS packages are client accounts and confirmed before purchase.

terms.title: Content supply
terms.body: Client provides accurate menu descriptions, pricing, allergy warnings, and high-resolution dish photos.

terms.title: Staff training
terms.body: Includes live or virtual training for your floor managers and kitchen staff on processing orders and adjusting menu availability.

sections.calloutBody: Prices are one-time development fees for the scope stated. Payment processing fees (e.g. Paystack standard 1.95%) are deducted by the provider directly from customer payments.
